relevance.rationale: A 256-page lecture-note book on p-adic analytic geometry, p-adic period mappings, p-adic orbifolds/triangle groups and uniformizing differential equations (Ch. I analysis, Ch. II geometry, Ch. III group theory, plus three appendices). Every topic is adjacent to something QOU touches — periods (rem:transcendental-accounting), uniformization of a Riemann surface by a triangle group (Bring's surface), p-adic completions (rem:q-exp-p-adic, prop:adelic-reeb-restricted-product) — but the adjacency does not produce a consumable result. QOU's p-adic content is convergence radii for q-exponentials/q-dilogarithms and a valuation-additivity statement over places; it contains no period mapping, no Gauss-Manin connection, no p-divisible group, and no non-archimedean uniformization. Reading the table of contents and introduction, I cannot name a QOU block that wants a theorem from here. Scope-(a) statement: this document, as read, supplies nothing this folio currently consumes — not a claim that p-adic period theory is irrelevant to the framework's future.

proposedActions.rationale: Identified and judged; no target in the corpus wants a result from it. If a p-adic period programme is ever opened (e.g. a p-adic reading of rem:transcendental-accounting's depth filtration), Ch. I §5 and Ch. III §4 would be the entry points and this row should be re-triaged.
